title: mctp-smbus: propagate the SMBus physical addresses to subdissectors
description:
MCTP subdissectors that track per-device state need a stable endpoint identity. The MCTP Endpoint IDs are not one: they are only assigned during the MCTP discovery phase, so before assignment the host is the null EID 0 and the device EID differs between a request and its response. The SMBus 7-bit slave addresses underneath are stable for the life of the bus.

Publish them in pinfo-\>net_src/net_dst before handing the frame to the MCTP dissector, so a subdissector (NVMe-MI, next) can key its conversations on the physical address pair and keep per-device state apart in a multi-device topology. The address type is AT_MCTP while the payload is an SMBus address rather than an EID; that overload is deliberate (there is no AT\_ type for SMBus addresses) and is documented at the assignment.

Also gate the dissector on the captured length, not just the reported length: invoked directly through "Decode As", a snaplen-truncated frame can report a large length while holding only a few captured bytes, and the fixed-header reads would then throw a bounds exception mid-dissection. The heuristic path already applied that guard. Finally, only set the "SMBus/I2C / " protocol column (with its fence) when the MCTP subdissector will actually run and append its own name after it; otherwise the trailing separator was left dangling.

AI-Assisted: yes (Claude)
